title: Keyed reputation and sandbox pages (batch p2-G07-1: crowdsec_cti, abuseipdb, virustotal, hybrid_analysis)
notes: Manual follow-up pages of the keyed G07 modules, emitted when automation is skipped (licence, needs_key, quota, blocked: P152 cond 2, P157 cond 2, P174 cond 3) and, for VirusTotal, always (P158 cond 6). Report and search pages only; nothing here submits, uploads, rescans or downloads samples. All four sites are single-page applications that were not fetched (unverified); AbuseIPDB pages answer scripts with a Cloudflare check (research 2026-11-25), so they are for manual opening in a browser only.

links.label: CrowdSec CTI (console page of the IP)
links.notes: Path used by CrowdSec's own tooling; single-page app, not fetched (it may ask the analyst to sign in to the company's CrowdSec console). Manual use only (P152 cond 2).

links.label: AbuseIPDB check page
links.notes: Report page of the IP (read-only; never the report form). Cloudflare check for scripts: manual opening in a browser only (P157 cond 2).

links.label: VirusTotal IP report
links.notes: GUI report page (single-page app, not fetched). Read-only: never the upload or rescan pages (P158 cond 2, cond 6).

links.label: VirusTotal domain report
links.notes: GUI report page (single-page app, not fetched).

links.label: VirusTotal file report
links.notes: GUI report page of a file hash (never an upload: the hash is looked up, the file is never sent).

links.label: VirusTotal search
links.notes: GUI search by value (the URL form of the search, never a URL scan submission). Manual link of the virustotal module for every accepted type.

links.label: Hybrid Analysis search
links.notes: Report search by hash (JS application, not fetched); never the submission pages (P174 cond 2).

links.label: Hybrid Analysis sample overview
links.notes: Overview page of a SHA-256 (JS application, not fetched).
